newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Irkutskenergo sees ADR issue in few days.
newsitem.headline: Irkutskenergo sees ADR issue in few days.

text.p: Russian regional utility Irkutskenergo said it expected to launch its American Depositry Receipts (ADRs) programme in a matter of days, a senior company official said on Tuesday.

"We signed the final addition to the depositary agreement with The Bank of New York the day before yesterday," economics director Valentin Mezhevich told Reuters. "By my calculation, ADR placement could begin in a few days."
Shares of AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii (Irkutskenergo) had firmed to $0.240 at 1250 GMT from $0.205 at the close on Monday on the Russian Trading System.
